scientific.integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically and independently checked by exhaustive finite enumeration. The complete-bipartite formula is treated as a specialization rather than as the originality-bearing statement.
limitations: The accessible 2016 proceedings record is one page and does not identify its standard-family computations.
A separately indexed author-uploaded copy and the full 1998 article were not accessible from the sources inspected, leaving residual special-case overlap risk.
Finite exhaustive verification through order nine is corroboration only; the arbitrary-order theorem rests on the symbolic proof.

title: Paired-domination polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
